behaviours: every parser (nvidia-smi header and query, etimes, rank table, pdb, colabfold log, reporter file, engine rate line, af2 timing rows) gives the recorded values on the box output
each parser on a truncated, field-missing or error-line copy raises ValueError or gives an explicit null, never an invented value
a stage given malformed rank table, pose, nvidia-smi output, colabfold failure or truncated rows exits 2 with RUN_DONE and a failure record
a stage given an empty --in exits 2 and names the missing file
stages that call a program several times (anchor, aux, af2, md, downloads, capability) keep each call's working directory and outputs apart
guard stage arithmetic follows REMOTE_TIMEOUT and budget: stop by time, go, stop by budget, anchor stop left undecided
reference pose scored against itself and against a rigid copy gives overlap 1.0 and RMSD 0
a rotated copy is rejected by the frame guard as an exit 2 failure, never scored
anchor diagnostics are recorded in the anchor record
anchor miss gives exit 4, FAIL and run_valid false
every later record after a miss carries run_valid false, the voided-by text and the label
calibration_valid on later records is decided by their own checks, not by the anchor
the anchor verdict is unchanged by later stages
MD atom count and NaN energy checks make C2 calibration_valid false
control records and the sleep control failure
env_check record, lock mismatch and unset lock hash fail with exit 2
anchor, endpoint, downloads and rows records carry the directive's fields and units
m4_summary has the compute table with every stage, and RUN_VALID.json, RUN_DONE and env.txt are written
a stage writes only under --out
a stage that finishes its work exits 0
